executive_summary: Your RED status stems entirely from peer volatility signals that lack confirmed root causes—five high-exposure suppliers (GPI, EVE Energy, Texas Instruments, and others) showing unexplained stock declines of 2–3% with no disclosed reasons. This warrants immediate investor-relations outreach to clarify whether these are sector-wide headwinds, company-specific issues, or noise. Separately, your geopolitical exposure is concentrated and material: four suppliers (Huizhou BYD, Smoore, IP Sun, Porton) face identical US-China trade and Taiwan risks, while three others (Stora Enso, Sappi, ITC) sit in NATO/regional flashpoints. These are not emergencies yet, but they share root causes and deserve consolidated contingency planning—map dual sourcing options for EMS and batteries in particular, since Huizhou BYD and Smoore are marked critical exposure. The domestic US suppliers (GPI, Texas Instruments) merit quick financial health checks to rule out sector distress before escalating to supply-chain actions.
